abstract: Network Solutions is an easy, phone-supported start for small sites. Independent tests found below-average speed and 99.89% uptime, and renewal is about three times the promo price.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

mainEntity.name: Is Network Solutions good for hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is easy for beginners and has phone support. Tests found speed below average and renewals about three times the promo price.

mainEntity.name: How much does Network Solutions hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter is $2.99 a month and renews at $8.83. Essential is $4.99 renewing at $15.42, and Premium is $6.99 renewing at $18.75.
HostWise measured a 402 ms median time to first byte and a 2,280 ms Largest Contentful Paint over 34 weeks.
HostWise measured 99.89% uptime and HostDean saw no major outages. The guarantee is 99.9% with exclusions.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have phone support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. HostWise lists 24/7 phone and chat.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: We did not find one on the hosting page we read.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have a free domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for one domain on an annual term. The free SSL certificate covers one annual term on Essential and Premium. Starter has no free SSL.

mainEntity.name: Is Domain.com the same as Network Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions, per HowToHosting, and new hosting purchases route there.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have AI features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Its hosting page lists a drag-and-drop AI Website Builder, and HostingAdvice praised it.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have hidden fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reviewers warn about checkout add-ons, auto-renewal by default and expensive domain and SSL renewals.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have a Black Friday deal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its blog lists SITEWIDE30 for 30% off an AI All-Access Pack from 23 November to 7 December 2026. It is not a hosting discount.
People who want fast pages, a low price for years or a simple checkout.
